description: the exactly-once corpus (ROADMAP-SMB.md B4). Identical server capabilities to durable.json, and deliberately so: a replay is only answerable from a CreateGuid the server bothered to record, and chimera records one only when persistent_handles is on. What distinguishes this cell is the FLAVOR (stepReplay), which stamps ChannelSequence and SMB2_FLAGS_REPLAY_OPERATION on ordinary requests.
